# Legal Framework
Access UIDAI’s legal framework, including the Aadhaar Act 2016, amendments, ordinances, and related laws governing identity, authentication, and service delivery in India.

Acts
Access Aadhaar Acts, amendments and ordinances forming the legal framework for Aadhaar services and subsidy delivery in India.
View All
Rules
The Unique Identification Authority of India has notified a comprehensive set of rules to govern its operations and Aadhaar ecosystem. These rules define frameworks for governance, financial reporting, authentication, data security, and service delivery, ensuring accountability, transparency, and efficient functioning.
View All
Regulations
The Unique Identification Authority of India periodically issues regulations and amendments to strengthen the Aadhaar ecosystem. These updates ensure secure authentication, efficient enrolment and update processes, data protection, and streamlined governance, adapting to evolving technological and administrative requirements.
View All
Judgements
The Unique Identification Authority of India is guided by key judicial pronouncements that shape the legal and constitutional framework of Aadhaar. These judgements address issues of privacy, governance, and service delivery, ensuring lawful implementation and protection of citizens’ rights.
